items.title: How AI is helping to open a new chapter for ancient Chinese literature
items.raw_content:
For generations, working with ancient Chinese texts has been a painstaking task. Specialists would spend years deciphering unfamiliar characters, copying manuscripts by hand, adding punctuation to texts written without it, comparing different editions and tracing references scattered across thousands of years of records.
But artificial intelligence is now changing that process, not only by helping to preserve fragile manuscripts but also by transforming how ancient texts are recovered, studied...

items.title: DeepSeek Raises V4 API Prices Significantly, Effective August 17 — Peak-Off-Peak Pricing With Up to 500% Hikes
items.raw_content: DeepSeek announced updated API pricing for its V4 model family on August 13, effective August 17, adopting peak and off-peak pricing with off-peak rates half of peak. Off-peak V4 Pro input prices rise as much as 500% for cache hits, while the V4-Pro-0813 model posted a DeepSWE score jump from 7.3 to 62.7.

items.title: China's First Technology Achievement Supermarket Opens at CAS SIAT — Scan a QR Code, Take the Tech Home
items.raw_content: The Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences has opened the country's first technology achievement supermarket, shelving more than 1,000 research outcomes color-coded by track, each with a QR code linking to its technical details. Since 2025 it has driven signed contracts worth nearly 250 million yuan.

items.title: China's First Standing-Posture Passenger eVTOL Debuts in Hangzhou — Kufei's Urban and Dream Series Target Consumer Flight
items.raw_content: Hangzhou-based aircraft company Kufei has released Urban, the world's first standing-posture single-person electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, alongside the seated Dream series. Both are powered by the self-developed dual-redundant NA80 flight controller, and Kufei has built the industry's first bundled insurance scheme with PICC and CPIC.

items.title: DeepSeek's 'Black Whale' Surfaces: Harness Developer Preview Open-Sourced Under MIT — Everything Is a Plugin
items.raw_content: On August 13, DeepSeek released the official V4 Pro model and the developer preview of DeepSeek Harness, open-sourced under the MIT license. Built on the Cordis plugin system, Harness treats every agent capability as a plugin and ships append-only session logs with full trajectory tracing.
